name: Haus Alpina
beschreibung: The Gasthof Haus Alpina is located on a quiet side street of a village in Tirol, surrounded by mountain scenery. The traditional façade and the parlour retain elements of the regional architectural style. The guest rooms are functionally furnished, and some have a balcony with a view of the valley. The kitchen emphasizes Austrian dishes and uses regional seasonal ingredients. Public transport and hiking trails can be reached from the house in just a few minutes. The house offers a small wellness area with a sauna and relaxation room. Limited parking is available at the house.
